about_short_description.short_description: The Chefz operates as a gourmet food and sweets delivery platform.

product.name: The Chefz Food Delivery Platform
product.description: An online marketplace that lets customers browse menus from restaurants and food merchants, place orders, choose payment and delivery options, and receive prepared food at a specified address.

product.name: Restaurant and Food Merchant Marketplace
product.description: A digital marketplace where restaurants and food-related businesses list menus and products for customer discovery, ordering, delivery, and local visibility.

product.name: Food Delivery Service
product.description: A logistics service that assigns delivery representatives to collect orders from participating merchants and deliver them to customers’ selected addresses.

product.name: Restaurant Table Reservations
product.description: A reservation service that allows users to book tables at participating restaurants through The Chefz platform, with available pricing and venue information.

product.name: Online Payment and Order Support
product.description: Platform services for paying for orders, receiving electronic invoices, tracking fulfillment, submitting complaints, and receiving eligible refunds or wallet credits.
